channel.title: Pakistan Textile Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pakistan Textile Journal (ptj.com.pk)

item.title: Barmag Unveils POY 2.0: Energy-Efficient and Semi-Automated Yarn Production - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: Barmag introduces POY 2.0, a next-generation spinning concept for energy-efficient and semi-automated POY yarn production showcased at ITMA Asia + CITME 2025.

item.title: Global Cotton Production to Fall 4% in 2026/27: ICAC Report - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: Global cotton production is projected to fall 4% to 24.8 MT in 2026/27 while consumption remains stable, according to ICAC market outlook.

item.title: Cotton Made in Africa Supports Women in African Cotton Farming - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: Cotton made in Africa highlights how targeted investments, training, and community programs are empowering women in African cotton farming.

item.title: VIATT 2026 Opens in Vietnam, Connecting ASEAN Textile Industry with Sustainability and Technology - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: VIATT 2026 brings together the ASEAN textile sector in Vietnam with global exhibitors, sourcing opportunities, and textile innovations.

item.title: U.S. Cotton Trust Protocol Opens Grower Enrollment for 2026 Crop Year, Expanding Opportunities for U.S. Cotton Producers - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: U.S. Cotton Trust Protocol opens 2026 grower enrollment and launches a Field Partner Program supporting regenerative farming and traceable sustainable U.S. cotton.

item.title: DyStar Gabus Plant Earns ISO 14001 Sustainability Certification - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: DyStar ISO 14001 certification reinforces the company’s commitment to sustainable manufacturing, environmental management, and reduced carbon footprint.

item.title: Monforts unveils interactive digital platform for textile finishers - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: Monforts digital platform features 3D tours of textile finishing technologies, improved customer support tools, and machinery upgrade solutions.

item.title: Sedo Treepoint to Showcase Smart Textile Tech at Techtextil 2026 - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: Sedo Treepoint at Techtextil 2026 will present smart automation and MES solutions for technical textile focusing on efficiency, transparency and sustainability.

item.title: ALLIED Feather + Down and Partners Launch a Circular Apparel Innovation with Peak Performance - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: ALLIED Feather + Down, NetPlus, Resortecs and Peak Performance launch a revolutionary circular apparel innovation designed for full recyclability and sustainability.

item.title: YKK Zipper Innovation Wins iF Design Award 2026 for Sustainable Repair - Pakistan Textile Journal
item.description: YKK zipper innovation highlights a sustainable repair solution that replaces damaged elements without changing the entire zipper.
